title: Approvals forked across clones are refused until one fresh approval
description: Approvals forked across clones are refused until one fresh approval
acceptance_criteria: a change approved separately on two branches that then merge is refused by definition-approval validation (check, audit, status) naming both approvers and the fresh approval that settles it; one fresh change approve on the merged branch settles it; approvals that only append are not a fork

answers.constraints: no network lock; relayed_by is not compared (REQ-change-relay-repair-001); change approve itself is not refused, so the recovery stays available
